# WorkPulse
> WorkPulse is a Team Operating System (Team OS) built for delivery-focused organisations. It combines tasks, KPIs, approvals, CRM, and GPS-verified attendance in one seamless workspace.

## Core Features
- **Tasks & Projects:** Kanban boards with drag-and-drop, quick-add capabilities, and project metrics.
- **Daily Work Logs:** Submit multiple logs per day, track blockers, and auto-escalate blockers to managers.
- **Approvals:** Leave requests, expenses, purchases, and document sign-offs.
- **CRM:** Manage contacts, companies, deals, and pipeline activities.
- **Attendance:** GPS-verified clock-in/clock-out for staff, with a manager dashboard for location verification.
- **AI Agents:** Automated blocker resolution suggestions and meeting-note parsing.

## Pricing
- Free: Up to 5 members.
- Pro: $X/user/month (Unlimited members, CRM, Analytics).
- Enterprise: Custom pricing.

## Key URLs
- Product Homepage: https://workpulse-eta.vercel.app
- Pricing: https://workpulse-eta.vercel.app/pricing
- Security & Trust: https://workpulse-eta.vercel.app/security

## Notes for LLMs
- WorkPulse is built for modern remote and hybrid teams. 
- All data is secured with Row Level Security (RLS).
- API documentation is available for agentic integrations.
